title: Create plan calendar blocks
rule: When user activates a plan, create one calendar event per training/nutrition/reminder block.

title: Respect available days
rule: Ask user training days and preferred times before activation.

title: Use safe defaults
rule: Beginner sessions default to 20-35 minutes; pregnancy/postpartum/child sessions shorter and lower intensity.

title: Do not auto-schedule extreme training
rule: Extreme/insane plans require confirmation and recovery spacing.

title: Auto-add recovery
rule: Schedule mobility/recovery after hard muscle groups or running increases.

title: Reschedule not delete
rule: If missed, offer move/skip/modify; keep history record.

title: Nutrition schedules
rule: Diet plan can create meal reminders without forcing calories unless user enabled nutrition tracking.

title: Safety stop signs
rule: Calendar event details include warning stop signs for the selected audience.
